sentences.text: 1 For the Petitioner: Mr. Tarun K. Sharma, Advocate vice Mr. Narender Singh Thakur, Advocate.
For the Respondents: Ms. Menka Raj Chauhan, Deputy Advocate General.
Ms. Menka Raj Chauhan, learned Deputy Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondents.
2. Petitioner is presently serving as Assistant Commissioner (Food Safety), Shimla.

The case set up by him in this writ petition is that he was posted as Designated Officer in the office of Chief Medical Officer, Kinnaur in April, 2017, where he discharged his duties till September, 2022.
On completion of almost five years in the Whether reporters of print and electronic media may be allowed to see the order?

Yes. 
hard & tribal area, petitioner was transferred on 12.09.2022 to the office of Chief Medical Officer,
Shimla, however, on 06.02.2023, the petitioner was given additional .
charge of the post of Assistant Commissioner (Food Safety), Kinnaur in addition to his own duties as Assistant Commissioner (Food Safety), office of Chief Medical Officer, Shimla.
The grievance highlighted by the petitioner is that the additional charge of the post in tribal area is creating a lot of difficulties for him.
That he had already served tribal area for about five years.

Petitioner's grievance is that he has filed a representation to respondent No.3 on 16.05.2024 (Annexure P-5) for withdrawing the additional charge from him, but the same has not been decided till date.

3.
